name: 暴怒·伤害加倍
skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var rageStance = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'rage-stance'; }); if (!rageStance) return { success: false, message: '' }; var baseDamage = context.damage || 0; context.damage = baseDamage * 2; return { success: true, message: piece.name + '暴怒姿态：伤害翻倍！' + baseDamage + '→' + context.damage + '点' };
